notes: Undo toast — swiping a take away now shows a 5-second Undo option instead of deleting it instantly
Share button on each take — sends the take as a real .wav file to WhatsApp, Messages, etc. via the share sheet (falls back to a direct download if the browser doesn't support file sharing)
Daily streak counter — shows next to "Last 5 takes" once you've recorded on 2+ consecutive days; resets if a day is missed
Settings → Profile row now shows your actual avatar and name directly in the list, instead of a generic label — tap it to rename or re-choose your avatar, same as before
That row always reflects your latest name/avatar, even right after editing
Added a Reset app option in Settings
Avatars now load from avatars/manifest.json — add new ones without touching the app code
Fixed reels showing mismatched colors/directions during forward and reverse playback
Fixed a timer bug from tapping Rec then Stop very quickly
Replaced the browser's native confirm popup with an in-app themed dialog
Renamed Terms & Conditions to Privacy Policy and moved it inline (no more separate page)
Settings list order is now fixed — removed drag/reorder
Profile avatar now replaces the gear icon and opens Settings
Initial release — record, play forwards/reversed, pitch & speed control, last 5 takes, onboarding and tutorial
